summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL formatting entry and Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (buffers only when is_terminal, returns True/False, no Windows calls); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title with the title; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Not run: per instructions, no tests, scripts, or Black were executed, so formatting was checked by hand against 88 characters and nothing is verified by execution. Choice to check: the Console test skips on sys.platform == "win32" as an approximation of legacy Windows. No commits were made. Non-terminal dropping already happens in _render_buffer, so no change was needed there.
